fixed: A dance or program that Device Sync has shared is now cleared when it has been in Recently deleted longer than your "Keep deleted items for" setting, instead of staying there for good. As with Permanently delete, its content is erased on all your devices and only a small deletion record is kept. The setting syncs, so it applies on all your devices.

changed: `DanceRepository.purgeDeleted` and `ProgramRepository.purgeDeleted` now blank an expired published record instead of leaving it whole. They do not restamp its existence, and still return only how many records they erased.
